## Statement

Open question: whether the proved Genesis statement that an attempted change is obstructed exactly when it adds an xrx or identifies two related terms (PG-GEN-ONGOING-OBSTRUCTION), and the S(n) off-image refusal (PG-SN-OFF-IMAGE-REFUSAL), are finite instances of a not-possible task. Both are decidable refusal predicates on a finite model. The source notion of a not-possible task concerns the existence of a constructor with arbitrary accuracy, which neither predicate mentions. Only an analogy is established.

## Governing obligation

The repository predicates are decided by the structure of the attempted change; the imported notion is decided by what a constructor could do. A bridge would need a model of constructors on the Genesis regime.
